_source_note: Fully rebuilt (2nd pass, Sept 2026) from 35 real in-game tooltip screenshots pulled directly from Ascension by Kyle (Priimalist.docx). Major corrections: Geode Barrage is 10 Mana/16 Physical dmg at Rank 1 (was modeled with Nature-ish flavor and higher numbers); Wildclaw is 30 Rage (was 20); Earthquake is Lvl 16 and a Nature DoT+slow (was Lvl 10 flat Physical AoE); Hand of the Earthmother is Lvl 6 (was 4); Mountain Hammer moved to Mountain King spec tree (was wrongly class-wide) and corrected to Lvl 26. Added the Seismic spell family (Geode Barrage/Seismic Crash/Seismic Spike/Seismic Tremor/Seismic Wave, shared cooldown), the Boon family (Turtle/Bear/Wolf/Hawk/Lion, mutually exclusive via exclusive_group), and the Instinct family (Grove/Primal, mutually exclusive). Rank-1 starting-ability values from this batch supersede the earlier session's guessed numbers.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: A basic weapon strike.

abilities.name: Geode Barrage
abilities.description: Fling stones at an enemy, dealing Physical damage and generating Rage. Shares a cooldown with other Seismic spells. (Real physical damage - was previously miscategorized as a spell effect_type, which incorrectly scaled it off Spell Power; fixed to match its own confirmed screenshot data.)
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 10 Mana, 30yd, 1.8s cast, '16 Physical Damage and generating Rage' at Rank 1. Core level-1 Rage generator, extended to 8 ranks per Kyle's rank-up direction.

abilities.name: Wildclaw
abilities.description: Strike with both weapons at once.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 30 Rage (was 20), melee range, instant, 'Requires Melee Weapon', 'Weapon Damage plus 4' at Rank 1. Core level-1 Rage spender, extended to 8 ranks.

abilities.name: Seismic Crash
abilities.description: Create stalactites that strike your enemy 3 times, generating Rage. Real physical damage (was previously miscategorized as spell_damage, which incorrectly scaled it off Spell Power - fixed to match its own confirmed screenshot data: '90 Physical damage', and Primalist's real Strength/melee-hybrid identity per the class resource reference). Shares a cooldown with other Seismic spells.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 2, '90 Physical damage over 1 sec. Generates 20 Rage.' Second Rage generator alongside Geode Barrage, part of the Seismic family.

abilities.name: Stoneshard
abilities.description: Launch a sharpened stone at an enemy. Deals additional damage per Earthshaping stack. (Real physical damage - was previously miscategorized as a spell effect_type, which incorrectly scaled it off Spell Power; fixed to match its own confirmed screenshot data.)
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 4, '60 Physical damage. Deals 5% additional damage for each Earthshaping stack.' Earthshaping stack-scaling not yet modeled dynamically.

abilities.name: Hand of the Earthmother
abilities.description: Rejuvenate an ally.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 6 (was Lvl 4), 'healing them for 66' at Rank 1. Extended to 8 ranks.

abilities.name: Boon of the Turtle
abilities.description: Reduce your damage taken and cause you to deal Nature damage to melee attackers. Only 1 Boon may be active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 4, '-10% damage taken, 4 to 3 Nature damage to melee attackers.' Part of the mutually-exclusive Boon family (Turtle/Bear/Wolf/Hawk/Lion).

abilities.name: Boon of the Bear
abilities.description: Increase melee attack power, melee haste, and Rage generated from auto attacks. Only 1 Boon may be active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 8, all +10%.

abilities.name: Primal Instinct
abilities.description: Invoke a savage instinct on an ally, increasing Attack Power. Players may only have one Instinct on them at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 8, '+30 Attack Power. Lasts 30 min.' Part of the mutually-exclusive Instinct family (Grove/Primal).

abilities.name: Therazane's Rage
abilities.description: Generate a burst of Mana and Rage, then continue generating both for a short time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 10, 'Generates 10% maximum mana and 20 Rage, plus an additional 2 Rage and 3 mana every 2 sec for 10 sec.'

abilities.name: Heart of the Mountain
abilities.description: Therazane favors you, greatly increasing your threat generated.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 14, '+150% threat generated.' Real tank cooldown.

abilities.name: Nature's Call

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 16, 'leading up to 3 enemies attacking the ally target to attack the Primalist instead for 3 sec.'

abilities.name: Boon of the Wolf

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, '+25% movement speed, +8% dodge.' Part of the Boon family.

abilities.name: Ursoc's Bellow
abilities.description: Bellow with the might of Ursoc, reducing the Attack Power of nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Soothing Touch

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 22, 'removing 1 poison and disease effect from them.'

abilities.name: Fae Dust

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 30, '+150 Armor, +6 all stats, +5 all resistances. Lasts 30 min.' A major raid buff.

abilities.name: Boon of the Lion
abilities.description: Increase your chance to resist fear, charm, and sleep effects, and periodically dispel them from nearby party members. Only 1 Boon may be active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 30, '+40% resist fear/charm/sleep, dispel 1 such effect from party members within 30 yds every 3 sec.' Part of the Boon family.

abilities.name: Essence of Nature

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 44, '+45 Nature Resistance. Lasts 10 min.'

abilities.name: Grove Instinct
abilities.description: Invoke a calm and earthly instinct on an ally, restoring mana over time. Players may only have one Instinct on them at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 2, 'restoring 5 mana every 5 seconds.' Part of the mutually-exclusive Instinct family.

abilities.name: Boon of the Hawk

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 6, '+12% spell haste, -10% spell/ability cost, regenerate 1% max health every 5 sec.' Part of the Boon family.

abilities.description: Throw a hammer at an enemy, dealing Physical damage and stunning them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Mountain King-locked (was wrongly class-wide), Lvl 26 (was 20), '80 Physical damage and stunning them for 5 sec.'

abilities.name: Seismic Tremor
abilities.description: Send an escalating tremor through the earth at an enemy. Shares a cooldown with other Seismic spells. (Real physical damage - was previously miscategorized as a spell effect_type, which incorrectly scaled it off Spell Power; fixed to match its own confirmed screenshot data.)
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Geomancy-locked, Lvl 26, '157 Physical damage, plus an additional 1080 over 24 sec, dealt slowly at first and building over time. Damage dealt generates 1 Rage.'

abilities.name: Seismic Wave

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Grovekeeper-locked, Lvl 22, 'healing for 111 to up to 8 allies in a 25 yd radius and 68 Nature damage in a 10 yd radius around you.'

abilities.name: Terrasurge
abilities.description: Unleash a globe of earth at an enemy, piercing defensive effects and reducing their Armor. (Real physical damage - was previously miscategorized as a spell effect_type, which incorrectly scaled it off Spell Power; fixed to match its own confirmed screenshot data.)
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Mountain King-locked, 45 Rage, 30yd, 2.5s cast, 20 sec cooldown, '271 Physical damage and reducing their Armor by 50% for 10 sec. Pierces through absorption, deflection, and reflection effects.'

abilities.name: Primal Rush

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Wildwalker-locked, Lvl 18, '102 Nature damage. Generates 20 Rage.'

abilities.name: Rylak's Bite

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Wildwalker-locked, Lvl 20, 2 Charges, 10 sec recharge, '120% Weapon Damage plus 14.' Real pet-combo ability.

abilities.name: Totemic Smash

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Wildwalker-locked, Lvl 22, '140% Weapon Damage plus 51. Deals an additional 30 damage to up to 5 enemies within 8 yds.'

abilities.name: Primal Shred
abilities.description: Command your pet to shred nearby enemies, causing them to bleed. (Real physical damage - was previously miscategorized as a spell effect_type, which incorrectly scaled it off Spell Power; fixed to match its own confirmed screenshot data.)
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Wildwalker-locked, Lvl 20, 'command your pet to shred up to 5 enemies within 8 yds, causing them to bleed, dealing 82 Physical damage over 21 sec.' Real pet-command ability.

abilities.name: Raptor Talons
abilities.description: A leaping strike that deals bonus damage to a wounded target.
abilities._source: Kept from earlier pass - real numbers not yet confirmed via this screenshot batch.

abilities.name: Spirit Beast Master
abilities.description: Tame a Raptor to fight alongside you, replacing any pet you currently have.
abilities._source: Built during the pet-system push (Oct 2026, Kyle: 'We need the pet system up and running... since we have hunters, warlocks, primalist, and wind spec stormbringer', then correcting: 'Primalist tames beasts like hunter, not elementals'). Previously stubbed as a self-buff with no real mechanic - the real tooltip ('You may now tame beasts... to aid you as a companion') is itself the unlock/first-tame moment, same real shape as Hunter's own Tame Beast, so this ability now IS the tame cast directly (talent-gated via Spirit Beast Master's own unlock_ability, rather than baseline like Hunter's) instead of a separate no-op buff sitting in front of a taming system that didn't exist. Also added Primalist as a real pet_type to pet_screen.py and combat/pet_templates.py (new 'raptor' template) so this has an actual roster to pick from, same real acquisition flow as Hunter's taming screen.

abilities.name: Bring Me Their Bones
abilities.description: A devastating execute against a heavily wounded enemy. Real physical damage - was previously miscategorized as spell_damage despite being Rage-costing (its own resource_type) with a real execute_threshold_pct field, both strong signals this is a physical execute like Warrior's Execute, not a spell.
abilities._source: Kept from earlier pass - real numbers not yet confirmed via this screenshot batch.
